Hana Park: Postmortem takeaway: recurring eviction cascades during short token-burst windows. Need a minimal, ownerable follow-up: promptset, nightly replay, short load harness, and a quick on-call runbook. Who picks what?

Luca Rossi: I can do the nightly replay job. Plan: replay captured 10m windows around incidents, preserve timing, and fail if fallback_rate > 1% within first 5m. Will add a `--fast` local mode. Target: create CI job and PR by Tue.

Priya Mehta: I'll own the promptset + eval harness. Will add ~20 short/long context pairs and assertions for variant selection and token continuity. Will include a mock model so CI is stable. PR by Wed.

Darren Cole: Ops/infra: I'll sketch a short runbook for oncall and a one-off chaos job for staging (30s GPU mem throttle). Also add dashboards: eviction_rate, fallback_count, nightly_pass_rate. Playbook draft by Thu.

Hana Park: Good. Quick timeline recap: Luca -> replay CI (Tue), Priya -> promptset PR (Wed), Darren -> runbook + chaos job (Thu). ops-bot create INC follow-up and schedule 20m sync next week.

ops-bot: Created ticket #INC-6208 "eviction-triage: promptset, replay, load, runbook" assigned to Hana Park, due 2025-10-10. Sync scheduled: 2025-09-29 14:00 UTC.

Luca Rossi: Repro command for local dev: `./tools/replay --trace traces/eviction/sep-2025.json --preserve-timestamps --fast`. I'll add `ci/jobs/eviction_replay.yml`.

Priya Mehta: Promptset snippet: `- id: long_prefix_01\n  input: "A"*7000\n  expect_contains: "continued"\n  assert_variant_not: tiny`. Will add negative cases and expectations.

Darren Cole: Runbook note: if nightly replay fails 2x, post to #eng-oncall and pause any ongoing model swaps. Also capture `KV_LOG_LEVEL=debug` logs during chaos job and upload to s3: `s3://redwood-test/eviction-drills/218888`.

Hana Park: Thanks — owners noted. If anyone hits blockers, drop a message in this thread or DM me. We'll confirm progress in the scheduled sync. :thumbsup:
